Unknown vs Rahul And on 23 February, 2026
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
Sl. Office Notes,
No. Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C528 No. 2318 of 2025  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. S.C. Burman, learned counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned Dy. A.G. with Mr. Vikas Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By the instant application, moved under Section 528 of BNSS 2023, applicants, namely, Rahul and Sonu are challenging the proceeding of Complaint Case No. 16 of 2023, Chhoti vs. Rahul and others, wherein they have been summoned to face the trial for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 354 IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
4.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicants that the allegations, as alleged, are false and frivolous and several attempts were made to settle the matrimonial dispute in between applicant no. 1 and respondent no. 2-complainant.
Even as on date, applicant no. 1 is ready to live with the respondent/ complainant.

Learned counsel further submits that initially complainant moved an application under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C. on 05.11.2022 which was converted to a complaint case and the concerned trial court summoned the applicant by order dated 19.10.2023 without making any effort for their amicable settlement.
5. Issue notice to respondent no. 2.
6. Steps to be taken within three days.
7.
Let the respondent may file counter affidavit within three weeks.
One week thereafter is granted to the applicants to file rejoinder affidavit.

8. List this matter on 24.03.2026 in order to enable applicant no. 1 and respondent no. 2 to be remain present before this Court.

1 9.

Taking into consideration that the applicant no. 1 come up with a stand that he wants to settle the dispute with respondent/complainant (wife) and wants to live together, this Court is of the view that efforts should be made for their amicable settlement.

Since, counter affidavit is called, till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Complaint Case No. 16 of 2023, Chhoti vs. Rahul and others,
pending the court of Addl. Second Civil Judge/ Addl. C.J.M. Roorkee, District Haridwar shall remain stayed.
